questionText: [Set 30.1] In a single knockout tournament with $N=11$ teams, the total number of matches played and the number of byes awarded are, respectively:

options.text: 11 matches and 6 byes
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: 10 matches and 4 byes
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: 10 matches and 5 byes
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Knockout Tournament Fixture Bye Formula.

options.text: 12 matches and 5 byes
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Yoga and Yogic Practices (Knockout Tournament Fixture Bye Formula):
10 matches and 5 byes

Detailed Context:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Physical_Education (Management of Sporting Events - Knockout Tournament Fixture Bye Formula):
Number of matches in a knockout tournament is $N - 1 = 11 - 1 = 10$. The next higher power of 2 is $2^4 = 16$. Number of byes = $2^n - N = 16 - 11 = 5$ byes.

Hence, Option (D) is the correct answer.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Match the diabetes-managing asana in List I with its key procedural step in List II:

List I:
(A) Bhujangasana (Cobra Pose)
(B) Paschimottanasana (Seated Forward Bend)
(C) Pawanmuktasana
(D) Ardha Matsyendrasana

List II:
(I) Lying prone, placing palms beside chest, lifting head and torso arching the spine like a serpent
(II) Sitting in Dandasana, bending forward from hips to hold big toes with forehead toward knees
(III) Lying supine, bending knees toward chest, clasping shins with fingers and lifting chin to knees
(IV) Seated spinal twist with one leg bent over thigh and arm bracing against the opposite knee

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Bhujangasana lifts chest prone; Paschimottanasana folds forward seated; Pawanmuktasana hugs knees supine; Ardha Matsyendrasana twists seated.
Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.
